scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: My backpack has got 23 things inside. Valentina says 20 of them are little machines. She is correct.
scene.intro: My backpack has got twenty-three things inside, says Erik proudly. Valentina looks at them one by one: a pencil case, a ruler, two rubbers, some glue, scissors, three notebooks… and a small stone. Twenty of these things you don't need, she says. Erik has got an answer for each one. Have you got a ruler? Have you got glue? Open your bag and count what YOU have got!

data.script: Valentina: Backpack check! Erik, what have you got? … Erik: I've got three pencils, a green ruler and my robot notebook. … Valentina: Sofia has got new scissors with orange handles. … Erik: Mateo has got a pencil case shaped like a fish! … Valentina: And he's lost his rubber again — the third one this month. … Erik: I've got glue, crayons and a sharpener that collects the bits. … Valentina: An invention? … Erik: Of course! Nothing falls on the floor. Teacher-approved!
